 Coram:

The Hon'Ble Miss Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order
01 . (Through hybrid mode)

1. This CRLMP has been filed for direction to the Opposite Party Nos.2 and 3 for expeditious completion of investigation, arrest of the accused persons and other allied reliefs in connection with Laxmisagar P.S. Case No.359 of 2025.

2. Mr. A.K. Apat, learned Additional Government Advocate produces the instruction dated 05.03.2026 of the IIC, Laxmisagar Police Station wherein it is stated that during investigation, the accused Pratap Kumar Mishra had appeared at the Police Station and produced a copy of the "Not to Arrest" passed by the High Court in ABLAPL No.3589 of 2025.
Accordingly, notice under Section 35(3) of the BNSS was served upon him, as the offences under Sections 408/420/465/468 IPC are punishable with imprisonment up to seven years.
He was directed to appear before the Court as and when required.
After completion of investigation, on 01.03.2026 charge- sheet No.133 dated 01.03.2026 has been submitted against him.
3. In view of above development, no direction is required to be issued in this CRLMP, which is accordingly disposed of.
(Savitri Ratho) Judge RKS Dr. Biswanath Pattanaik vs State Of Odisha on 5 March, 2026
